scripts.build: npm run prepare:web && npm run typecheck && vite build --config vite.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.test:web: npm run prepare:web && npm run build:domain && node web/tests/site-data.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run prepare:web && npm run build:domain && python3 -m scripts.evaluate_reference_cases --output build/python-reference-results.json && node web/tests/all.test.mjs
